objective.description: Dashboard load feels slow on large accounts.

expected.summary: Lead with "Pin the current measurement as an external guardrail" (high), then investigate before changing code. 1 test suggestion, 2 fix steps.

suggestions.title: Pin the current measurement as an external guardrail
suggestions.rationale: Runtime measurements were supplied without an explicit budget; pinning them stops silent regressions while the target is negotiated.

draft.description: Given the supplied measurement as a provisional baseline, when the metric is measured externally in CI, then it must not regress beyond the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Profile before changing code
steps.description: Measure and locate the bottleneck first; optimization guesses usually miss.

steps.title: Optimize the located hotspot, guarded by the measurement
steps.description: Apply the smallest effective change and keep the external guardrail as the arbiter.

risks.description: Optimizations often trade readability or memory for speed; the measurement must justify the trade.

fixPolicy.rollback: Revert the optimization if the external measurement shows no improvement or a regression elsewhere.

evidence.detail: Caller requested performance: Dashboard load feels slow on large accounts.
